value_stream.name: Corporate Real Estate & Property Portfolio Management

fields.Participants: Director, Facilities & Real Estate, Real Estate Investment Mgr, Finance/Treasury (links to VS-18), Strategy (links to VS-33), Store Ops (links to VS-37), Legal
fields.Trigger: Strategic cycle (links to VS-33); store-growth pipeline (10–15 new stores/year per profile); financing-window opportunity

Automation Opportunity: - System rule-based auto-approval of "approves strategy, ownership thresholds, and delegation of authority" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-520 (ensure controlled execution — Property Acquisition, Investment & Portfolio Strategy (PA-97.1).)
- operational: geographic diversification and VS-69 disaster-resilience standards; operational: disciplined underwriting (W3186) and exit-option analysis (W3192)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Concentration risk**: Over-weighting one region/island exposes portfolio to typhoon and seismic clustering; mitigated by geographic diversification and VS-69 disaster-resilience standards
- **Own-vs-lease mis-judgment**: Acquiring sites that later underperform locks capital and creates stranded assets; mitigated by disciplined underwriting (W3186) and exit-option analysis (W3192)
System Touchpoints: - Strategic plan/portfolio (links to VS-33); capex (links to VS-40); treasury/funding (links to VS-18); governance/authority (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Real Estate Investment Mgr maintain portfolio strategy: own-vs-lease decision framework per site (links to VS-42 lease/buy analysis), target ownership mix, geographic concentration limits (Mindanao/Visayas/Luzon/NCR), yield/NOI targets, capital deployment envelope; align to VS-33 strategic plan and VS-37 store-opening pipeline

Finance/Treasury (links to VS-18/VS-40) model portfolio capital plan: acquisition capex, development capex, recurring capex (TI/RC), debt capacity, cash-flow waterfall, target leverage and coverage ratios; integrate with group capex envelope (links to VS-40) and VS-72 intercompany framework

Investment committee (CEO/CFO/COO/Board where required by VS-36 governance authority matrix) approves strategy, ownership thresholds, and delegation of authority; feed approved pipeline to VS-37 store-opening and VS-20 site-selection processes

fields.Participants: Real Estate Investment Mgr, Store Ops (links to VS-37), Finance, Legal, Construction (links to VS-20.2), Category/Trade Area (links to VS-01/VS-44)
fields.Trigger: Identified acquisition opportunity from VS-37 store pipeline or broker/off-market

workflows.name: Site Acquisition & Real Estate Investment Underwriting

Automation Opportunity: - System rule-based auto-approval of "approves/rejects per authority matrix" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-520 (ensure controlled execution — Property Acquisition, Investment & Portfolio Strategy (PA-97.1).)
- operational: benchmarking to comparable BuildRight stores and third-party demographic data; operational: W3191 due-diligence gating
Pain Points / Risks: - **Demand-overstatement risk**: Optimistic trade-area assumptions inflate NOI; mitigated by benchmarking to comparable BuildRight stores and third-party demographic data
- **Hidden-cost risk**: Undiscovered environmental, geotechnical, or title issues erode returns; mitigated by W3191 due-diligence gating
System Touchpoints: - Underwriting model; trade-area/geo analytics (links to VS-44); construction cost (links to VS-20.2); capex (links to VS-40)
Time Estimate: - 3–6 weeks per opportunity to investment-committee decision

steps.activity: Real Estate Investment Mgr underwrite the opportunity: trade-area analysis (population, income, competitor proximity, demand drivers per VS-44), site physical characteristics (lot size, frontage, zoning, access, parking, flood/seismic exposure per VS-69), projected store revenue (links to VS-33), development cost (links to VS-20.2), NOI, cap rate / IRR / yield-on-cost, sensitivity to rent and occupancy

Construction (links to VS-20.2) / Engineering assess physical feasibility: geotechnical, environmental, utilities, permitting complexity (links to VS-22/VS-76), demolition/abatement, construction cost and schedule; flag deal-breakers
Investment committee approves/rejects per authority matrix (VS-36); on approval, authorize due diligence (W3191), LOI/offer, and exclusivity; on rejection, archive and capture learning

fields.Participants: Real Estate Investment Mgr, Legal, Finance/Treasury (links to VS-18), Tax (links to VS-79/VS-87), Broker, Seller
fields.Trigger: Approved acquisition (W3186); leasehold-to-freehold conversion; sale-and-leaseback (SLB) offer from an operating counterparty

workflows.name: Land & Building Purchase and Sale-and-Leaseback Origination

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documentary stamp tax on real-estate conveyance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-register of "Register of Deeds" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-520 (ensure controlled execution — Property Acquisition, Investment & Portfolio Strategy (PA-97.1).)
- operational: W3191 title insurance and ENC verification; operational: upfront tax planning (links to VS-79)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Title-defect risk**: Encumbrances, liens, or adverse claims surface post-closing; mitigated by W3191 title insurance and ENC verification
- **Tax-leakage risk**: Poor structuring triggers uncapped VAT/DST; mitigated by upfront tax planning (links to VS-79)
System Touchpoints: - Contract/CMS (links to VS-88); treasury/escrow (links to VS-18); tax (links to VS-79); fixed-asset booking (links to VS-35)
Time Estimate: - 6–14 weeks per transaction (2–6 + 2–4 + 2–4, per the step durations)

steps.activity: Real Estate Investment Mgr structure the deal: outright purchase (land/building), sale-and-leaseback (acquire from owner-operator and lease back — links to VS-96 equipment leasing for asset-finance parallel), joint venture, or ground lease; price per appraisal (W3189) and underwriting (W3186); negotiate price, deposit, conditions, and timeline

Legal/Tax (links to VS-79/VS-87) structure for tax efficiency: DST (documentary stamp tax on real-estate conveyance), VAT on sale (if seller is VAT-registered — pass-through analysis), capital-gains tax borne by seller (verify), CGT/estate/transfer-tax exposure, holding-entity selection (Property Mgmt Inc. vs Holdings); draft/review Deed of Absolute Sale, sale-and-leaseback lease, and conditions

Execute closing: title transfer (Register of Deeds), tax payment (CGT, DST, transfer tax to LGU/BIR), possession handover, payment release via escrow (links to VS-18); book acquisition at cost (W3189/VS-35)

fields.Participants: Property Development Mgr, Construction (links to VS-20.2), Store Ops (links to VS-37), Finance/Project Accounting (links to VS-40), Permitting (links to VS-22/VS-76), Design/Architecture
fields.Trigger: Approved development (W3186) or tenant-improvement (TI) requirement for a leased-up property
fields.Volume: ~10–15 developments/year (aligned to store openings per VS-37) + ad-hoc TI

workflows.name: Property Development, Ground-Up Construction & Tenant-Improvement Build-Out

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-schedule of "schedule, phasing for operating sites" (replaces manual Step 1).
Controls: - CTL-520 (ensure controlled execution — Property Acquisition, Investment & Portfolio Strategy (PA-97.1).)
- operational: GC bond, milestone payments, and VS-40 cost control; operational: capitalization policy (links to VS-35/VS-40)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost overrun / schedule slip**: Construction risk on provincial sites (labor, materials, weather per VS-69); mitigated by GC bond, milestone payments, and VS-40 cost control
- **Capitalization-error risk**: Mis-classifying operating repairs as capex (or vice versa) distorts NOI and tax; mitigated by capitalization policy (links to VS-35/VS-40)
System Touchpoints: - Project/capex accounting (links to VS-40); construction mgmt (links to VS-20.2); permits (links to VS-22/VS-76); fixed assets (links to VS-35)
Time Estimate: - 9–18 months per ground-up development; 4–12 weeks per TI

steps.activity: Property Development Mgr/Design finalize development brief: site plan, building program (selling area, backroom, yard, parking, loading), sustainability targets (green-building per VS-78), budget and schedule, phasing for operating sites; obtain design approvals (links to VS-20.2 W223 new store design)

Construction (links to VS-20.2) execute: bid/buy (W224), build (W225), commissioning/handover (W227); track costs against budget via VS-40 project accounting; manage change orders, RFIs, and TI allowance; ensure LGU building permits and occupancy certificate (links to VS-22/VS-76)

Finance (links to VS-40) capitalize qualifying costs to investment property (land, hard costs, directly attributable soft costs, borrowing costs per PFRS 23 where applicable); at substantial completion, transition to investment-property accounting (W3189) and activate depreciation for owner-occupied portions (links to VS-35)

fields.Participants: Valuation Mgr, External Valuer, Finance (links to VS-17), Director, Facilities & Real Estate, Auditor (links to VS-22.2)
fields.Trigger: Annual reporting cycle; acquisition/disposition (W3187/W3192); impairment indicator; financing/refinance event

Automation Opportunity: - System continuous audit of "Valuation Mgr engage independent, PRC-accredited appraiser" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "record fair-value movement" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "methodology, appraiser credentials, and key assumptions" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-520 (ensure controlled execution — Property Acquisition, Investment & Portfolio Strategy (PA-97.1).)
- operational: independent appraiser, market-data benchmarking, and audit challenge; operational: transparent disclosure and sensitivity analysis
Pain Points / Risks: - **Valuation-bias risk**: Aggressive cap rates inflate carrying value and equity; mitigated by independent appraiser, market-data benchmarking, and audit challenge
- **P&L volatility**: Fair-value swings flow through P&L; mitigated by transparent disclosure and sensitivity analysis
System Touchpoints: - Valuation/appraisal module; GL/consolidation (links to VS-17); audit (links to VS-22.2)

steps.activity: Valuation Mgr engage independent, PRC-accredited appraiser (independence per audit requirements, links to VS-22.2) to value each investment property at fair value under PFRS 40; provide lease, rent-roll, NOI, cap-rate comps, and market data; specify valuation date and basis (highest-and-best-use, existing-use)

Finance/Valuation (links to VS-17) record fair-value movement: gain/loss to P&L (PFRS 40 fair-value model) or disclosure under cost model; reconcile to prior period; perform impairment review where indicators exist (vacancy, seismic/typhoon damage per VS-69, market decline)

Auditor (links to VS-22.2) reviews valuation methodology, appraiser credentials, and key assumptions (cap rate, discount rate, terminal value); finance responds to audit findings; final fair values incorporated into consolidated FS (links to VS-17.2)

fields.Participants: Treasury (links to VS-18), Director, Facilities & Real Estate, Finance, Legal, Lenders, Investment Committee

workflows.name: Real Estate Capital Stack & Financing Structuring

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "Legal/Treasury negotiate facility documentation" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-520 (ensure controlled execution — Property Acquisition, Investment & Portfolio Strategy (PA-97.1).)
- operational: headroom, hedging (links to VS-18); operational: board leverage limits
Pain Points / Risks: - **Refinance / covenant risk**: Breach of LTV/DSCR covenants triggers default; mitigated by headroom, hedging (links to VS-18.3), and proactive lender communication
- **Over-leverage risk**: Excess debt erodes equity returns and resilience in downturns; mitigated by board leverage limits
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/debt (links to VS-18); legal/mortgage (links to VS-88); GL (links to VS-17); property P&L (W3201)

steps.activity: Treasury (links to VS-18) structure capital stack: equity (Property Mgmt Inc./Holdings), senior debt (bank loan, bond), mezzanine if any; LTV, DSCR, and covenant targets; select funding instrument (term loan, revolving, project finance, sale-and-leaseback proceeds (W3187)); assess intercompany funding vs external

Legal/Treasury negotiate facility documentation: loan agreement, mortgage/real-estate mortgage (REM), assignment of leases and rents, guarantees (Holdings), covenants, events of default; perfect REM with Register of Deeds; coordinate DST on mortgage (links to VS-79)

Finance (links to VS-17/VS-18) book debt, capitalize borrowing costs (PFRS 23 where directly attributable to qualifying assets per W3188), set up amortization, and integrate debt service into property-level cash flow (W3201) and treasury forecasting (links to VS-18.1)

fields.Participants: Real Estate Investment Mgr, Legal, Title Officer, Surveyor, Environmental Engr (links to VS-24/VS-73), Finance, Broker

workflows.name: Property Due Diligence, Title Transfer & ENC Acquisition

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "check DENR/ LGU land-use and zoning" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-escalate of "escalate to Phase II sampling if warranted" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "Acquire clean title and ENC" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-520 (ensure controlled execution — Property Acquisition, Investment & Portfolio Strategy (PA-97.1).)
- operational: title search, insurance, and indemnities from seller; operational: Phase I/II ESA and contractual indemnity
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hidden-encumbrance risk**: Undisclosed liens/easements impair use and resale; mitigated by title search, insurance, and indemnities from seller
- **Environmental-liability risk**: Contaminated site transfers liability to buyer under Philippine environmental law; mitigated by Phase I/II ESA and contractual indemnity
System Touchpoints: - Title/land registry; environmental (links to VS-24/VS-73); records (links to VS-88); property master (links to VS-29)

steps.activity: Legal/Title conduct title due diligence: Certified True Copy of Original/Transfer Certificate of Title (TCT/OCT) from Register of Deeds, trace title chain, identify encumbrances (mortgages, liens, easements, adverse claims, annotations), verify tax declarations and real-property-tax clearance (links to W3202), confirm lot boundaries via geodetic surveyor, check DENR/ LGU land-use and zoning (links to W3206)

Environmental Engineer (links to VS-24/VS-73) conduct Phase I environmental site assessment: historical land use (contamination risk — paints, chemicals, fuel), wetland/floodplain, asbestos/lead in existing structures; escalate to Phase II sampling if warranted; engineering due diligence (structural, geotechnical, utilities)

Acquire clean title and ENC: clear identified encumbrances prior to close, obtain title insurance where available, execute Deed of Sale, register transfer at Register of Deeds, secure new TCT in Property Mgmt Inc. name; archive all DD documentation (links to VS-88)

fields.Participants: Real Estate Investment Mgr, Director, Facilities & Real Estate, Finance, Tax (links to VS-79), Legal, Broker, Store Ops (links to VS-59)
fields.Trigger: Strategic review (W3185); underperformance; redevelopment opportunity; portfolio rebalancing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "prepare disposition case" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System workflow orchestration of "coordinate with Store Ops for vacate timing" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "update portfolio master and analytics" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-520 (ensure controlled execution — Property Acquisition, Investment & Portfolio Strategy (PA-97.1).)
- operational: pre-planned disposition window and valuation floor (W3189); operational: upfront tax planning (links to VS-79)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fire-sale risk**: Pressured disposition crystallizes loss; mitigated by pre-planned disposition window and valuation floor (W3189)
- **Tax-leakage risk**: Suboptimal holding structure increases CGT; mitigated by upfront tax planning (links to VS-79)
System Touchpoints: - Portfolio/disposition module; tax (links to VS-79); fixed-asset derecognition (links to VS-35); GL (links to VS-17)

steps.activity: Real Estate Investment Mgr/Finance prepare disposition case: holding vs selling analysis (NOI trend, cap-rate movement, alternative-use value, redevelopment optionality), estimated proceeds vs carrying value, gain/loss and tax impact (CGT, links to VS-79), use of proceeds; obtain investment-committee approval (VS-36)

Broker/Legal market the property: marketing package, targeted buyer list (REITs, developers, owner-operators), data room (links to VS-88), NDA, offers, negotiation; coordinate with Store Ops for vacate timing (links to VS-59 store closure) or sale-leaseback to a third-party occupant

Execute sale: contract, due diligence support to buyer, closing and payment, title transfer, tax settlement (CGT/DST/transfer tax, links to VS-79), derecognition from investment property (W3189/VS-35) and gain/loss booking (links to VS-17); update portfolio master and analytics (W3208)
